title: Traditional Greek Tiropita
description: A classic Greek savory pie made with feta cheese and a flaky phyllo crust.

ingredients.name: Feta cheese
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a Whole30 compliant feta cheese option.

ingredients.name: Phyllo dough
ingredients.amount: 1 package (usually found in the freezer section)
ingredients.notes: Thaw the phyllo dough according to package instructions.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.notes: Beaten eggs are used to help hold the phyllo dough together.

ingredients.name: Melted butter
ingredients.notes: Used to brush the phyllo dough for a golden brown crust.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds flavor to the filling.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds a punch of flavor to the filling.

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped parsley adds a pop of color and freshness to the dish.

instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to package instructions.
Cut the phyllo dough into 4 equal pieces.
In a bowl, crumble the feta cheese and mix in the chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Place one piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush with melted butter.
Place a quarter of the feta cheese mixture in the center of the phyllo dough.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo dough and feta cheese mixture.
Brush the tops of the tiropitas with melted butter and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake the tiropitas in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
